import {listSharedAssets,listSharedArtwork,sharedArtwork,sharedArtworkDefaults,sharedArtworkImage,type SharedArtworkImageDelivery,type SharedArtworkLocation} from 'NAUTILUS_ARTWORK_METADATA';
const rows=listSharedAssets({category:'Artwork'});
const record=sharedArtwork(rows[0].artworkPin);
const defaultGraphic=sharedArtworkDefaults(rows[0].artworkPin);
const image:SharedArtworkImageDelivery=sharedArtworkImage(rows[0].artworkPin);
const location:SharedArtworkLocation=image.locations[0];
const id:string=record.id;
const revision:number=record.revision;
const wrap:'clamp'|'repeat'=defaultGraphic.wrap;
const profile:'renderer'|'assets'|'compatibility'=location.profile;
const sourceImageView=image.imageView;
const all=listSharedArtwork();
// @ts-expect-error Exact Pin uses revision/contentDigest; historical identity is separate.
sharedArtwork({id:'historical',version:1,digest:'historical'});
// @ts-expect-error An ID alone is never an implicit latest lookup.
sharedArtwork('id-only');
void [id,revision,wrap,profile,sourceImageView,all];
